description: This file defines a Java class 'ProductFeatureServices' that provides various service methods related to product features within the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods handle retrieving product features by type, finding variants based on features, and managing product categories and variants, primarily for e-commerce or product management functionality.

classes.name: ProductFeatureServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling product feature related services such as retrieving features, variants, and product categories within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductFeaturesByType
methods.description: Retrieves product features grouped by type based on supplied category ID, group ID, or product ID, with optional filtering by application type.

methods.name: getAllExistingVariants
methods.description: Finds existing product variants that share a set of features as specified for a given product.

methods.name: getVariantCombinations
methods.description: Generates all possible product variant combinations based on product features, identifies existing variants, and assigns default IDs.

methods.name: getCategoryVariantProducts
methods.description: Retrieves variant products for a product category, filtering by selected features.
